title: Critical fails
source: Critical Rolls (Game Master's Toolbox), Nord Games, pp. 5–14. Open Game Content under OGL 1.0a.

columns.melee: Who turned out the lights? If you are wearing headgear, it slips over your eyes. You are blinded and must use a bonus action to reposition it.
columns.ranged: Whoops! Reroll attack against the closest creature to the target (other than yourself).
columns.natural: You taste AWFUL. If this attack was a bite, you are poisoned for 1d4 rounds.
columns.magic: Backfire. The effects of the spell are reversed; any harmful effects are applied to you (and the target replaces 'you' in the spell description, if applicable) at half the potency. If a beneficial effect is intended to you or an ally, a random target in range is affected.

columns.melee: Tag team. The target of your attack can use its reaction to take the Help action.
columns.ranged: Volley. If the target of your attack has a ranged weapon, it can use its reaction to make a ranged weapon attack against you.

columns.magic: Hit cover. The target of your attack can use its reaction to move up to half its speed and take cover.

columns.melee: Two left feet. The target of your attack can use its reaction to take the Disengage action.

columns.melee: Left an opening. The target of your attack gains a 1d4 bonus to its next attack roll.

columns.ranged: Quick reflexes. If using a non-ammunition ranged weapon, the target can use its reaction to attempt a DC 10 Dexterity check, catching your weapon on a success.
columns.natural: Draw on ki. The target of your attack can channel the power within it to recover hit points equal to its challenge rating squared (minimum 1).
columns.magic: Magical retribution. If the target of your attack is a spellcaster, it can use its reaction to cast a spell. The spell it casts must only target you.
